name: AutoGuidance + CFG guider (xmarre)
plain: Runs CFG on a good model and a positive pass on a bad model, adding a capped push away from the bad one. Options choose the direction, a cap relative to the CFG update, a ramp over time, and how post-CFG hooks interact. Its paper mode mixes the weights instead of stacking them.
math:
sequential_delta (default): w=max(w_ag−1,0)
d by mode: bad_conditional c_g−c_b; project_cfg: part of d along CFG update; reject_cfg: d minus that part; raw_delta: CFG_g−CFG_b
Δ=w·d; cap: Δ←Δ·min(ρ_t‖U‖/(‖Δ‖+1e-8),1); x̂=x̂_cfg+Δ
ρ_t=ρ(f+(1−f)ramp(progress)); default ρ=0.35
multi_guidance_paper: a=clamp(w_ag−1,0,1): x̂=CFG at derived scale + a·w_total·(c_g−c_b)

props.params: cfg, w_ag, swap_mode, ag_delta_mode=bad_conditional, ag_max_ratio=0.35, ag_allow_negative=true, ag_ramp_mode=flat, ag_ramp_power=2, ag_ramp_floor=0, ag_post_cfg_mode=keep, ag_combine_mode=sequential_delta

label: from code
surprise: Default cap of 0.35 of the CFG update means a raised w_ag often changes nothing once the cap is reached.
